title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Payments Standing Against the Invoiced Total of an Arrears Fee
content:
**Where payments received in the window stand at or above the invoiced total that fell due in it**,
nothing stands to be charged and the amount the fee runs on is nil.

**Where payments received in the window stand above nil but below that invoiced total**, the amount the
fee runs on is what is left of the invoiced total after those payments.

**In any other case** the payments received in the window reduce nothing.

The window is the 12 months to the day the fee is raised: the invoiced total is what was invoiced on the
rate program with a due day falling in it, and the payments are those received on the program inside it.

| Payments received in the window | The amount the fee runs on |
|---|---|
| at or above the invoiced total | nil |
| above nil, below the invoiced total | the invoiced total less those payments |
| none at all | the payments reduce nothing |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** On a rate program under the Demand Service Rate Programs whose invoiced
total in the window is 5000 US dollars: payments of 5000 US dollars in the same window leave the amount
the fee runs on at nil, payments of 5200 US dollars leave it at nil likewise, and payments of 1500 US
dollars leave it at 3500 US dollars. Where no payment at all was received in the window, those payments
reduce nothing.
